title: What is good to do on Eid
intro: Clean, bathe, dress nicely, go early to the masjid – and share the joy!

learn.text: Good things to do for Eid

items: clean and decorate the house, the masjid and the area around them
recite something for the souls of our loved ones
go early to the masjid for Fajr
recite the takbirs and give as much sadaqah as we can
share the joy of Eid with others
help prepare Eid food and sweets
visit our closest family, neighbours, relatives and friends

learn.html: We help our parents prepare the Eid food and sweets. We greet our parents for Eid by kissing their right hand and giving them a small gift – and they give us an Eid gift too.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The good deeds are the same for both Eids. The only difference: on Eid al-Fitr it is good to eat something – like a date – after dawn and before going to the masjid; on Eid al-Adha it is good to not eat from dawn until after the Eid prayer.

practice.title: Good for Eid
practice.prompt: Tap everything that is good to do on Eid, then tap Check.

options.why: Eid is for sharing joy and love.

practice.title: Which Eid?
practice.prompt: Before the Eid prayer, what is good?

items.text: Eat a date before the Eid prayer
Don’t eat until after the Eid prayer

questions.q: How do we greet our parents at Eid?
options: Kiss their right hand and give a small gift

questions.q: Are the good deeds the same for both Eids?
options: Yes – with one small difference about eating
